meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆给多个子代理并行执行,并留下执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一份写好的工作计划,想让它被自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan across parallel subagents and keep an evidence log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want it executed for you

howto.what: 它会读取 .omo/plans 里的工作计划,自己不动手写代码,而是把每个复选框拆成子任务派给并行子代理执行,并用 Boulder 状态和证据账本跟踪进度,直到所有复选框验证通过。
howto.when: 当你输入 ulw-execute、要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划,或说「start work」时接管;若没有可选计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 选中 .omo/plans 下匹配的计划并逐条执行
每阶段开 PR,盯 CI 直到合并
没有计划时先生成 ulw-plan 计划

howto.what_en: Claude stops writing code itself: it reads a work plan under .omo/plans, splits each checkbox into sub-tasks, dispatches them to parallel subagents, and tracks Boulder state and an evidence ledger until every checkbox is verified.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say ulw-execute, ask to run a .omo/plans plan, or say "start work"; if no selectable plan exists it first calls ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Picks the matching .omo/plans plan and runs it
Opens a PR per phase, watches CI to merge
With no plan, bootstraps ulw-plan first
